overview: You opened a heading, Of Kings, and wrote that it is not a play. The folded sheet has five lines: lists, a banishment, a death, a landing, a crown handed across. You copied the heralds at Coventry onto the sheet and did not speak them. Verona is shut. There is no speech.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the shape, copied without speaking, and stopped before a line anyone could say.

key_provisions.text: the heralds copied and not spoken

assets.name: Holinshed, second volume
assets.disposition: Opened the heading Of Kings and set five lines

summary: Opened the heading Of Kings and set five lines
